source.location: Supplementary Material 2: final NONMEM control stream

typical_value_assumption: ETA1=ETA2=ETA3=0. No interindividual variability or residual-error observation is simulated.

verification_input.meaning: Normalized unit input for mathematical verification, not a treatment recommendation.

boundaries: Final control stream from Supplementary Material 2 only; the exploratory stream in Material 3 is not substituted.
The source data CSV, dosing records, NONMEM run and subject-level outputs are unavailable.
Initial unit amount in ABS is an explicit verification assumption; no source dosing record is replayed.
Apparent CL/F and V/F are used together without a separate bioavailability multiplier.
No patient input, dose selection, repeated treatment schedule, applicability decision or clinical prediction.
